setting.help: Consolidate all of a customer's subscriptions that are due to be billed on the same day onto a single invoice.
Comma-separated list of days after the invoice date (e.g. 2,7,14) on which a reminder is sent when an automatic payment fails.
Comma-separated list of day offsets relative to the next invoice date (e.g. 0,1,2,7,14,-2,-7,-14) on which a reminder is sent for subscriptions with no saved payment token.
